nodes.label: Custom Voxel Engine
nodes.rationale: A high-performance, deterministic custom voxel engine built natively for the browser using WebGL, WebWorkers, WebRTC, React Three Fiber, Rapier, Zustand, and IndexedDB.

nodes.label: Hybrid Server Tick Architecture
nodes.rationale: Decouples the core game logic (running at 20Hz Fixed Tick / Accumulator) from the visual rendering (up to 144Hz) to guarantee determinism, prevent network desyncs, and avoid death spiral CPU lock-ups by dropping missed ticks.

nodes.label: Snapshot Visual Interpolation
nodes.rationale: Network guest entities use Snapshot Buffering to seamlessly interpolate between ticks in the past, ensuring buttery-smooth visual framerates despite the slower underlying 20Hz simulation.

nodes.label: Voxel Pipeline & Greedy Meshing
nodes.rationale: Terrain chunks are generated off the main thread in a WebWorker pool. Geometry is extracted via Greedy Meshing and baked with ambient occlusion and custom lighting.

nodes.label: P2P Host-Authoritative Networking
nodes.rationale: Multiplayer is serverless, with the browser host acting as the server over WebRTC (PeerJS), propagating chunk differences and validating combat raycasts.
